problem.title: Largest Positive Integer That Exists With Its Negative
problem.problemStatement: Given an integer array, determine the largest positive integer K such that both K and −K exist in the array.
problem.input: • First line contains integer N. • Second line contains N integers.
problem.output: Print the required integer or -1 if no such value exists.
